references.text: The same theme of seeking the Lord with all one's heart and all one's soul, and the promise to find Him
The great commandment to love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul
Reiterates the call to turn back to the Lord with all one's heart and all one's soul
Solomon's prayer refers to turning back to God with all one's heart and all one's soul
The prophet Jeremiah conveys God's promise that they will find Him when they seek Him with all their heart
Joel calls the people to turn to the Lord with all their heart
Paul preaches repentance and turning to God, which is the central message of Deuteronomy 30:2
The Thessalonians turned from idols to serve the living and true God
